newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEP HIKES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEP HIKES GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES THUR.

text.p: Greek gasoline prices will be raised by 0.70 drachmas per litre and diesel prices by 2.70 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday and for one week, Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) said in a statement.

The price adjustments come after higher world gasoline and diesel prices, up by $3.4 per metric tonne and $11.4 respectively and a steady dollar/drachma parity. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
